lines: 我们赶快开始混合吧！

我花费了大量精力
日日夜夜照顾这只宝可梦，{be01}
现在它的状态已经达到了巅峰。
今天，胜利是属于我的！

The Toughness Contest is like
extreme, man!{be01}
Those muscular appeals...
Cascading sweat... I swoon!
您好！{be01}\n这里是宝可梦华丽大赛的\n接待前台。
期待您下次再参加！

在这儿能看到
很多宝可梦。{be01}
因此我每天闲逛
都会到这儿来。
I wonder what kind of Pokéblock I’ll get?\nThis is so exciting!

I made Pokéblocks with Mom, Dad and
Big Sister. They turned out great!{be01}
I bet you can make smoother, better
Pokéblocks if you have more people.
要让您的宝可梦\n参加华丽大赛吗？
您想听哪部分的说明呢？
期待您下次再参加！
您想让哪只宝可梦参加呢？
请拿好！
Please visit whenever you would like\nto enter a Contest.
您想要参加哪种华丽大赛呢？
I’m terribly sorry, but your Pokémon\nis not qualified to compete at this\nRank yet...
要用这些宝可梦参加华丽大赛吗？
非常抱歉，宝可梦蛋是\n无法参加华丽大赛的。
Your Pokémon appears to be in no\ncondition to take part in a Contest...

那么，我来为您的宝可梦
办理报名手续！{be01}
它的参赛编号是4号。
华丽大赛即将开始。

恭喜！您的宝可梦
获得了华丽大赛的胜利！{be01}
我们为您准备了奖品。
那么，这边请！
请稍后再来领取\n您的奖品吧。
我们将授予您这个奖章\n作为比赛的奖励！
主持人：恭喜获胜！\n期待您下次再参加！
Please pick up your prize at the\nreception counter later.\nPlease do compete again!

您想要参加哪个级别呢？
Did you want to make some Pokéblocks\nwith the Blender?
But you don’t have a Pokéblock Case.{be01}\nYou should get a Pokéblock Case and\nthen come see me.

Oh?
You don’t have any Berries?{be01}
If you don’t have any Berries,
you can’t make any Pokéblocks.
But your Pokéblock Case is full.{be01}\nYou should use some Pokéblocks before\nyou come see me again.
Let’s get started, then!{be01}\nWhich Berry will you put in?
That won’t blend, I’m afraid.\nIt isn’t that kind of Berry.
Oh...\nYou’ve made this old-timer sad...
Hello, there!{be01}\nOur Musical stage is open!

In a Musical, Pokémon dress up
in Props and dance on stage!{be01}
Here’s a Prop Case. It holds a set
of Props to get you started!
Oh! Fans from your last show left\nyou some presents!
Would you like to perform?
I’m sorry, but none of your Pokémon\ncan perform.
Please choose the Pokémon that\nwill perform.
Which show would you like\nto perform in?
Stardom
Forest Stroll
A Sweet Soirée
Exciting Nimbasa
Cancel
Great! Please walk this way!
We hope to see you on stage\nanother time.
